leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a WebSocket server using the ws library in Node.js
Configure the server to handle connection upgrade requests
Initialize authentication token validation during the handshake phase
Construct proper HTTP response headers for successful and failed authentication
Manipulate WebSocket connections based on authentication status
Integrate token parsing logic with the connection upgrade handler
Control connection flow by rejecting unauthenticated clients
